newsitem.title: USA: Texas/w Okla feedlot cattle Wednesday roundup-USDA.
newsitem.headline: Texas/w Okla feedlot cattle Wednesday roundup-USDA.

text.p: Trade was slow to moderate in the Panhandle area Wednesday, USDA said. Slaughter steers and heifers steady to $0.50 per cwt lower. Feedlots reporting moderate inquiry from buyers.
Sales reported on 4,900 slaughter steers and 1,600 heifers; 128,900 head confirmed for week to date which includes 15,000 formulated and 1,500 previously contract cattle to be shipped this week.
Note - all cattle prices based on net weights FOB the feedlot after a 4 percent shrink.
Slaughter Steers - Select and Choice 2-3 1050-1250 lbs 63.50-64.00. Pen Select, few Choice 2-3 1100-1200 lbs 63.00.
Slaughter Heifers - Select and Choice 2-3 1000-1150 lbs 63.00-64.00. Select, few Choice 2-3 1000-1100 lbs 63.00.
Wk to Date - 128,900 Week Ago - 27,400 Week Ago - 40,900
